statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // empty'); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window | if .current_usage then ((.current_usage.input_tokens // 0) + (.current_usage.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0) + (.current_usage.cache_read_input_tokens // 0)) elif (.context_window_size and .used_percentage) then (.context_window_size * .used_percentage / 100 | floor) else (.total_input_tokens // 0) end'); left=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // 100'); effort=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.effort.level // empty'); [ -z "$effort" ] && effort=$(jq -r '.effortLevel // empty' "$HOME/.claude/settings.json" 2>/dev/null); eff=''; [ -n "$effort" ] && eff=" · $effort"; tok=$(awk -v n="$used" 'BEGIN{if(n>=1000000)printf "%.1fM",n/1000000; else if(n>=1000)printf "%.0fk",n/1000; else printf "%d",n}'); printf '\033[01;36m%s\033[00m%s | ctx %s (%.0f%% left)' "$model" "$eff" "$tok" "$left"
